description: The server accepts the TCP connection and resets it before any HTTP response (a crashed or restarting server). The second request succeeds.
harness: Retry with exponential backoff and jitter; after 2 failures try the role's fallback model (if privacy allows); at most 4 attempts, then pause with reason connect_failed. A refused port (nothing listening) is the other connect_failed shape: point the provider at a closed port.
